question: Why must the teaching be denied to revilers of Shiva and slanderers of Kula Bhairava?
premises: The teaching must not be given to them
inference: Revilers of Shiva and slanderers of Kula Bhairava are excluded from receiving the teaching.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may refer to the deity or the tradition
plain_english: Not to a reviler of Shiva, O goddess, nor to a slanderer of Kula Bhairava.
